description: How have house prices moved in an EU country? Paid ($0.03 USDC): latest quarterly house price index (2015=100), 4- and 12-quarter % change and rank vs EU countries (Eurostat prc_hpi_q, CC BY 4.0). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/eu-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
